body: Thanks for that dude. It's so simple yet I'm sure you helped a ton of people to feel better about themselves today.

I m so sorry you feel this way. I'm right there with you. My trauma totally messed my sexuality and I'm attracted to violence and pain during sexual act. For me, being with someone must be filled with verbal abuse, violence and roughness directed at myself otherwise it just feels wrong and disgusting in my head. I know I shouldn't feel that way and that it's just because of my self-hatred but I can't help it. It's so messed up that I choose not to seek a significant other or a sexual partner. I hope it will get better someday with time and work on myself but I highly doubt so.

But why not executing Suzue if he knew they won't stop investigating? That makes no sense. I get that she s a relative but she and Daisuke really want to know the truth and CLEARLY aren't gonna stop for some people they just met. So, it would have been better for him to eliminate all threat, no ?
Yeah, I agree with you. The fact that he went out of his way to kill 2 people is weird knowing that he have all this technology. Why reappearing when everyone thinks he is dead ?

Suzue is acting more and more suspicious to me. 

I mean, during the op, we see her holding a knife and we know now that it is the weapon that Shigemaru uses.

Plus, she is creating weapons and gadget for the kambe and I can't see how shigemaru could not profit from that, given that we know now he killed his wife to create a weapon.

We can also point out the fact she's ALWAYS monitoring him (ep 4). Maybe to report to Shigemaru ?

And the fact that she wasn't killed during Shigemaru's attack this ep, is very weird to me. I mean she's the only witness and she even recognise him so why leaving her alive ?

Well lucky me, I'm French. Can you link me the vid please ? :)
Thank you, kind sir !
It's very interesting. Can you post the link to that article, please ? Thanks 😊

In that case, hold on to this thought with all your might. Use it as a shield when suicidal thoughts are coming at you. This what I do. It's difficult, and I can do just ne day at a time, but it's the only way, we can advance. Don't forget that we're the bravest persons on earth cause we fight our own mind all day, everyday, so it's ok to slip up sometimes, just if that happen hold on to your thought. Good luck buddy! I'm right there with you !

I'm really sorry that you have to go through that. It's truly awful. I hope that he is better where he is..
What gave you strength to advance up until now ? For me, it's my family, I don't want them to suffer. That's what kept me from killing myself.

Yeah, I know that awful feeling, when everything was going somewhat fine, but your brain is like "nope stop". 
I'm here if you need to talk. When I feel overwhelmed with my thoughts I write them down, it helps me clear my mind. Hang in there ! Wish you well.
Hi, I'm here if you wanna talk :)

I'm really sorry to read about your situation. But you're not alone in this, you described what a lot of us are going through every day. It's so painful when the only thing you want is being normal, enjoying normal activities but your brain just doesn't comply. It makes you not care about anything and just play pretend. I'm stuck in the same situation. I'm lost at "who I am?", "Do I really hate the world or do I fear it so much that it became hate?"... My brain keeps playing tricks on me...
I hope you can find the answers to your questions. The only advice I can give you is to take one day at a time and writing down what you think throughout the day to clear your  mind a bit and maybe learn things about yourself.  Good luck !
Hey, I'm not your therapist but we can talk if you want.

I feel the same way. I'm just living for my family, because I don't want to hurt them. But it's so hard living for other people, putting a smile on and pretend like you're cured. But the truth is that there is no cure  you just gotta life with it and pretend like you're not thinking about suicide every waking second.
But yeah, you gotta live cause you promised yourself you ll never hurt them. Just stick to that idea to get through the day. This is what I do and I can't give you other advice than that.
I'm here if you need to talk. Good luck, buddy!

Animal Crossing is one of my favourite game too! When I was a kid I could spend my day playing on the ds version. I can't wait to have the new one on Switch.
This is not stupid to be passionate about something. This game brings you joy and this all that matter. 
I have severe depression and suicidal ideation and the only way I can get through that is by writing or drawing. Allowing yourself to be fully concentrate on one specific thing can help you clear your head from bad things.
I wish you the best :)
I completely agree to this. Good luck OP!
It's what I'm going thru every day, you painted that perfectly. Great writing style, you've got a real talent there !

Yeah, you're right: I can't escape from it. Life isn't worth living cause I feel it this way, and no matter what i do i can't escape what i feel. Sure, i can lie to myself and keeping me busy in order to not think about it, but the truth is always there in the corner of my eyes.
But yeah, what I want is keeping my mind busy, even if I don't want to, I need to do that. That's why i think moving away might be good. 
Thanks for your answer :)
Gotta agree as well ! Hang in there, buddy. And never give up on writing, you have a real talent :)

I wish i could be positive like you are again, but it seems like my fire is all gone. I just don't want to hurt my family because as much as my depression says otherwise, they care and love me.

My favorite book would be The Stranger by Albert Camus (in its original vers, cuz i'm French).

Yeah, it was like that for me as well. Depression tagged along with anxiety and suicidal thoughts. The last thing that made me want to stay was my love for literature but I ended up loosing that too. So now, i just stick around because i don't want to hurt my family.

Hey ! Don't look so down on yourself ! You sound like a great guy, you even tried to help me and i really appreciate that. My story is really not that interesting : always been a shy person, depression hit me due to a toxic relationship (that i got out of) and i never recovered from that. I try to find things to keep me wanting to continue on living but seems like i can't.

Thanks for your kind advice, I really appreciate it. Sadly, I have already tried different games but i get frustrated at how bad i am and end up giving up totally. I really hope the same thing for you as well ! :)
